description:
About our brand and products:

Monolight is a home wellness brand built around premium infrared saunas designed to fit real homes — no contractor, no permanent installation, just a beautifully built cabin that plugs in and heats up. Our range includes three models: ONE (1-person), DUO (2-person), and PRO (2-person, full-spectrum). Every Monolight sauna is built from solid Canadian Hemlock wood with a red cedar-tone exterior finish, and comes standard with a heated floor and Red Light Therapy function. ONE connects to a standard household outlet — no electrician needed. DUO and PRO run on a dedicated circuit to power their higher-output heating. Assembly typically takes under an hour with two people, and every unit is backed by a 2-year warranty.

What makes us different:

PRO features our MonoGrid full-spectrum dual-wave heating system — 8 panels (4 full-spectrum + 4 carbon far-infrared) instead of the single-wave carbon heating most competitors rely on, for deeper, more even heat. Heated floors and Red Light Therapy come standard across the whole range, not as paid upgrades. Every model is engineered around roughly 25 low-EMF design parameters, and is FCC Certified, ETL Listed, and Bluetooth-enabled. We sell direct-to-consumer, which means better pricing than you'll find through traditional retail — and ONE is the rare 1-person infrared sauna that plugs into a normal wall outlet, so customers can be using it the same day it's assembled.

How affiliates can earn:

Commissions are tiered and increase automatically as your referred sales grow — every affiliate starts at Bronze:

ModelBronzeSilverGoldPlatinum
ONE8%10%12%14%
DUO10%12%14%16%
PRO12%14%16%18%

Your tier is based on units you personally referred and sold in the prior month (all models combined), reviewed monthly and adjusted automatically up or down:

  • Bronze: 0–2 units/month
  • Silver: 3–5 units/month
  • Gold: 6–10 units/month
  • Platinum: 11+ units/month

Commission is calculated on the actual sale price of orders tracked to you, and becomes payable after our standard 30-day return/claim-back window closes. (Note: during our Founders launch pricing window, ONE commission is temporarily capped at the Gold rate regardless of tier, to protect margin at that price point — all other model/tier combinations apply in full.)

How to promote us:

You can share either your unique trackable affiliate link or a personal discount coupon code with your audience — both are tracked back to you automatically, so you can choose whichever fits your content style best. Great-performing content for Monolight tends to be authentic and experience-led: unboxing and setup videos, "day in my sauna routine" content, before/after wind-down or recovery content, home spa/wellness room tours, and honest first-impression reviews. Please represent the product accurately using our approved language (wood, heating, and electrical specs above); reach out to us for current photography, product specs, and any approved messaging before creating paid or sponsored content.

Other information:

Questions about the program, your tier, or payouts? Reach us anytime at support@monolightsauna.com and we'll help directly. A reminder that commissions only become payable once an order has cleared our 30-day return/claim-back window — this applies to every tier and every model, with no exceptions. We review the whole tier structure regularly, so thresholds and rates may be refined as the program grows; you'll always be notified before any change affects your current tier.

term_and_condition:
Welcome to Monolight Saunas! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.


1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.


2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.


3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.


4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.


5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.


6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).


7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: monolight.wellness@gmail.com.


Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to monolight.wellness@gmail.com for support.
